title: Hypnosis Guide Fixes
intro: This is your hypnosis guide as it is in Git now, with your six answers of today in, and every fix of the comprehension check highlighted where it is. Fresh readers went through the whole guide beside your published version, sentence by sentence, and wrote down every place this one reads worse; I checked each (the audit).

114 fixes, one card per paragraph: 25 where a sentence doesn't read, 12 where a point was lost or changed, 77 small snags. Each fix changes only the words highlighted. Click Approve, Reject or Revise.

Fresh writers made the fixes, from your published wording where it fit, and I went through every one. Then a fresh reader read each fixed paragraph beside your published version: does it read clearly, does it say what yours says, and is it at least as easy to follow as before? All 114 passed (3 after a second fix).
Your own words (4 cards): places in text you wrote where a reader stumbled. Keep or Edit it.
None of these has been through Pangram yet: after your answers, the whole guide gets one recheck, and any fix that reads AI or below High comes back to you with the clearest version that passes.
Your answers save as you click. When you're done, click Copy my answers (or Save them as a file) and send them to me.

sense.label: Doesn't read
sense.about: Words a reader can't follow: a sentence that doesn't parse, a word that doesn't fit, an "it" or "this" with nothing to point to, or a list run together.

lost.label: Lost or changed
lost.about: A point, step or contrast your published version made that this one dropped or changed, so the passage now says less, or something else.

snag.label: Small snag
snag.about: A small thing a reader may trip on: a vaguer word, a lost nuance. A few words fix it.

his.label: Your own words
his.about: Words of yours that a reader found hard to follow. Keep them as they are, or edit them.
